os-mock-1-013.title: Test hard-link and symbolic-link behaviour
os-mock-1-013.instructions:
```text
$ cat gas.txt
He
Ne
$ ls -l
-rw-r--r--. 2 rudy rudy 6 Oct 11 06:00 gas-hard
lrwxrwxrwx. 1 rudy rudy 7 Oct 11 06:01 data -> gas.txt
-rw-r--r--. 2 rudy rudy 6 Oct 11 06:00 gas.txt
```
Rudy runs rm gas.txt. Which of the two commands cat gas-hard and cat data gives an error message afterwards?
os-mock-1-013.explanation: A hard link continues to refer to the file data after the original name is removed. A symbolic link stores the target path, so it becomes dangling when that target name is removed.
